1. Engagement Scope

This compliance review focuses on wage and hour practices for Elsworth Vane Partners's non-exempt workforce in 3 states. The assessment included a statistical analysis of timekeeping records for 251 employees and a review of meal and rest period policies and administration.

2. Methodology

A "desk audit" methodology was employed, consisting of a review of policies, procedures, and a sample of 251 transactional records provided by Elsworth Vane Partners. No on-site fieldwork or employee interviews were conducted as part of this limited-scope engagement.

4. Detailed Findings
WDR-2069-001LOWMONITORING
Observation

PCAOB Auditing Standard No. 18 requires disclosure of related party transactions not found in the 2016 10-K

Corrective Action Required

Engage external legal counsel to review variable pay documentation for identified employees and issue corrected award agreements within 60 days of this report.

Management Response

Management has reviewed the finding and concurs with the recommended corrective action. The action has been entered into our GRC system, and automated reminders have been assigned to the owner.

Owner: Vice President of Technology • Due: 2016-10-28
WDR-1076-002HIGHOPEN
Observation

Pay grade overlap exceeding policy threshold between consecutive salary bands

Corrective Action Required

All nonqualified deferred compensation plan documents shall be amended to conform with the distribution and election timing rules under IRC §409A, effective the next plan year.

Management Response

This issue has been escalated to the executive steering committee for prioritization and resource allocation. A formal response will be provided following the committee's next scheduled meeting on 2016-09-01.

Owner: Senior Director of Business Development • Due: 2016-12-28
WDR-1966-003MEDIUMOPEN
Observation

HIPAA privacy notice not provided to 251 new enrollees in the group health plan

Corrective Action Required

The General Counsel's office will maintain a log of all 10b5-1 trading plans, including adoption dates, cooling-off periods, and termination dates, to ensure ongoing compliance.

Management Response

Management has implemented the primary corrective action. We are now in a monitoring phase to ensure the new process is operating effectively. We will provide a final report after 90 days of monitoring.

Owner: Knowledge Management Specialist • Due: 2017-01-28
WDR-1675-004MEDIUMDEFERRED
Observation

PCAOB Auditing Standard No. 18 requires disclosure of related party transactions not found in the 2016 10-K

Corrective Action Required

Revise offer letter templates and employment agreement language to ensure consistency. All active employees with inconsistent documentation should receive amended agreements within 90 days of this report. Legal sign-off required before distribution.

Management Response

Corrective action is complete. The revised policy was approved by the Board on 2016-09-01 and has been communicated to all employees. A copy of the communication and the approved policy is attached as evidence.

Owner: Vice President of Strategy • Due: 2016-11-28
